strings.name: Diana Taurasi
strings.summary: Taurasi won three NCAA titles at UConn before playing 20 WNBA seasons, all with Phoenix. She won three league championships and the 2009 MVP award. Her shooting and ball-handling offense made her the WNBA's record scorer, while she won six consecutive Olympic golds with the United States. After retiring in 2025, she continued participating in public basketball activities.
